import numpy as np, sys, subprocess, random

MASK=0xFFFFFFFF
def expand(k):
    k&=0xFFFFF
    return (k ^ ((k<<16)&MASK) ^ ((k*12345)&MASK)) & MASK

def rotl2(t): return ((t<<2)|(t>>6))&0xFF
def rotr2(t): return ((t>>2)|(t<<6))&0xFF
def g(a,b,x): return rotl2((a+b+x)&0xFF)

# scalar f
def f(v):
    x0=v&0xFF; x1=(v>>8)&0xFF; x2=(v>>16)&0xFF; x3=(v>>24)&0xFF
    y2=g(x3^x2, x1^x0, 1)
    y3=g(x3,y2,0)
    y1=g(x1^x0,y2,0)
    y0=g(x0,y1,1)
    return (y0 | (y1<<8) | (y2<<16) | (y3<<24))&MASK

def finv(y):
    y0=y&0xFF; y1=(y>>8)&0xFF; y2=(y>>16)&0xFF; y3=(y>>24)&0xFF
    t0=rotr2(y0); t1=rotr2(y1); t2=rotr2(y2); t3=rotr2(y3)
    x3=(t3 - y2)&0xFF
    e10=(t1 - y2)&0xFF
    x0=(t0 - y1 - 1)&0xFF
    x1=e10 ^ x0
    x3x2=(t2 - e10 - 1)&0xFF
    x2=x3 ^ x3x2
    return (x0 | (x1<<8) | (x2<<16) | (x3<<24))&MASK

# sanity finv
for _ in range(100000):
    v=random.randint(0,MASK)
    assert finv(f(v))==v, v
print("finv ok")

def encrypt(pt, keys):
    left=(pt>>32)&MASK; right=pt&MASK
    right^=left
    for r in range(4):
        mixed=f(right^keys[r]); temp=right; right=left^mixed; left=temp
    left^=right
    return ((right&MASK)<<32)|(left&MASK)

def decrypt(ct, keys):
    left=ct&MASK; right=(ct>>32)&MASK
    left^=right
    for r in range(3,-1,-1):
        temp=left; left=right; mixed=f(temp^keys[r]); right=temp; left^=mixed
    right^=left
    return ((left&MASK)<<32)|(right&MASK)

# validate against C binary with random seeds
for _ in range(20):
    ks=[random.randint(0,0xFFFFF) for _ in range(4)]
    pt=random.getrandbits(64)
    out=subprocess.check_output(["/app/feal_bin","%x"%pt,"%x"%ks[0],"%x"%ks[1],"%x"%ks[2],"%x"%ks[3]]).decode()
    cline=[l for l in out.splitlines() if l.startswith("Ciphertext")][0]
    cval=int(cline.split("0x")[1],16)
    keys=[expand(k) for k in ks]
    mine=encrypt(pt,keys)
    assert mine==cval, (hex(mine),hex(cval))
    assert decrypt(cval,keys)==pt
print("encrypt/decrypt match C: ok")
PYEOF
cd /app && python3 attack.py

# ---------- MITM attack ----------
import time
pairs=[]
for line in open("/app/pairs.txt"):
    line=line.split()
    if len(line)>=2:
        pairs.append((int(line[0]),int(line[1])))
P=np.array([p for p,_ in pairs],dtype=np.uint64)
C=np.array([c for _,c in pairs],dtype=np.uint64)
A=((P>>np.uint64(32))&np.uint64(MASK)).astype(np.uint64)
R0=(P&np.uint64(MASK)).astype(np.uint64)
B=(R0 ^ A).astype(np.uint64)
R4=((C>>np.uint64(32))&np.uint64(MASK)).astype(np.uint64)
CR=(C&np.uint64(MASK)).astype(np.uint64)
L4=(CR ^ R4).astype(np.uint64)   # = R3
A=A.astype(np.int64); B=B.astype(np.int64); R4=R4.astype(np.int64); L4=L4.astype(np.int64)

def vf(v):  # vectorized f on int64 array of 32-bit vals
    x0=v&0xFF; x1=(v>>8)&0xFF; x2=(v>>16)&0xFF; x3=(v>>16>>0)&0; # placeholder
    x2=(v>>16)&0xFF; x3=(v>>24)&0xFF
    def gg(a,b,x):
        t=(a+b+x)&0xFF
        return ((t<<2)|(t>>6))&0xFF
    y2=gg(x3^x2, x1^x0, 1)
    y3=gg(x3,y2,0)
    y1=gg(x1^x0,y2,0)
    y0=gg(x0,y1,1)
    return (y0 | (y1<<8) | (y2<<16) | (y3<<24))

def vfinv(y):
    y0=y&0xFF; y1=(y>>8)&0xFF; y2=(y>>16)&0xFF; y3=(y>>24)&0xFF
    def rr(t): return ((t>>2)|(t<<6))&0xFF
    t0=rr(y0);t1=rr(y1);t2=rr(y2);t3=rr(y3)
    x3=(t3-y2)&0xFF
    e10=(t1-y2)&0xFF
    x0=(t0-y1-1)&0xFF
    x1=e10^x0
    x3x2=(t2-e10-1)&0xFF
    x2=x3^x3x2
    return (x0|(x1<<8)|(x2<<16)|(x3<<24))

N=1<<20
seeds=np.arange(N,dtype=np.int64)
exp=(seeds ^ ((seeds<<16)&MASK) ^ ((seeds*12345)&MASK))&MASK  # expand table

t=time.time()
# backward side: build dict shortkey->list of k3
from collections import defaultdict
Wtab=defaultdict(list)
for i in range(N):
    k3=int(exp[i])
    R2 = R4 ^ vf(L4 ^ k3)          # array
    D = vfinv(R2 ^ B)
    diff = (D ^ D[0]) & MASK
    key=diff[1:7].tobytes()
    Wtab[key].append((k3, diff))
print("backward built", time.time()-t, "entries", len(Wtab))

t=time.time()
solution=None
for i in range(N):
    k0=int(exp[i])
    R1 = A ^ vf(B ^ k0)
    V=(R1 ^ R1[0]) & MASK
    key=V[1:7].tobytes()
    if key in Wtab:
        for k3,diff in Wtab[key]:
            if np.array_equal(diff, V):
                # candidate; recover k1,k2 and verify full
                R2 = R4 ^ vf(L4 ^ k3)
                D = vfinv(R2 ^ B)
                k1 = int((R1[0] ^ D[0]) & MASK)
                k2arr = (R2 ^ vfinv(L4 ^ R1)) & MASK
                if np.all(k2arr==k2arr[0]):
                    k2=int(k2arr[0])
                    keys=[k0,k1,k2,k3]
                    if all(encrypt(int(p),keys)==c for p,c in pairs):
                        solution=keys
                        break
    if solution: break
print("forward search", time.time()-t)
print("SOLUTION keys(expanded):", [hex(k) for k in solution])

# decrypt ciphertexts.txt
cts=[int(l) for l in open("/app/ciphertexts.txt") if l.strip()]
with open("/app/plaintexts.txt","w") as fo:
    for ct in cts:
        fo.write("%d\n"%decrypt(ct,solution))
print("wrote", len(cts), "plaintexts")
PYEOF
cd /app && time python3 attack.py
